attempts.diagnosis: The loop cannot prove the shifted-prefix invariant after arr[i] := arr[i+1] because it needs arr[i+1] to be unchanged from the method entry. The existing unchanged-tail invariant only covers indices up to capacity - 2, so when i is capacity - 2 (or more generally when i+1 is the last index), arr[i+1] is not known to be old(arr[i+1]).
attempts.repair: invariant forall j : int :: i <= j < capacity ==> arr[j] == old(arr[j]);
